text:
O minister, take care not to wrong the wretched or strong; when taking gold and silver, remember you leave polished steel.


You leave sword and lance to the unfortunate, and power and reason to defeat you: starving people do not fear death.


Who sees certain ruin hates its cause more than ruin, and this enrages him.


He loves nakedness and grievance with despair when his oppressor offers vengeance.

translation.title: Now, O Minister, Fix Your Care
